headline: Tencent's hy4 hits all-time high, Xiaomi jumps 20 spots
summary: Tencent's hy4-preview-20260827 just claimed the top spot with a record 17.4% token share, vaulting past OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna. Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 rocketed 20 ranks in a single day to land at #6. Meanwhile, three models dropped off the board entirely: NVIDIA's nemotron-3-super-120b, Mistral AI's mistral-nemo, and Qwen's qwen3.8-flash.
highlights: tencent/hy4-preview-20260827 sets all-time token-share record at 17.4%
xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 surges 20 ranks to #6 with 3.8% share
